data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 冬日毛皮帽的坡道
data.description: 冬季上学路，她戴着哥萨克帽、围着围巾走在通往礼园女学院的坡道上，呼出白气；对路人的问候只回以最小的点头，古板而端正。

data.promptProse: Alice Kuonji walks uphill toward Reien Girls' Academy in a dark wool coat, plain scarf and rounded fur-trimmed winter hat. She answers a passerby's greeting with the smallest nod, breath visible beneath her composed face. The medium view follows the school road and bare roadside trees behind her. Morning light catches the fur edge and scarf weave, with longer blue-grey shadows on the slope and a gentle bright edge along her coat.
